artworks.title: Marcer (Draper)
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person entertaining two dogs while two figures watch from a window. In the image, the main subject is a person standing on the right, dressed in 18th-century clothing, pointing to two small dogs standing on their hind legs. The setting includes a building with a window on the left, where two figures lean out, observing the scene. The drawing is detailed with fine lines and contains an inscription at the bottom.

artworks.title: Fà ballar i Cani (Street Entertainer)
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of four people under a decorative archway and next to a column. The man on the far left is leaning on a staff and singing. To his right is a man playing a violin. Beside him is another figure playing a guitar or a lute. Slightly set apart from the group is a younger individual gesturing with one hand held out, holding a hat in the other. The background features a building with small windows, clouds, and a lined sky, capturing an urban street scene.

artworks.title: Seacoast with a Great Tree
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and touches of gray ink with gray washes on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a large tree as the main focus, filling much of the frame vertically. A faint horizon line is visible with distant trees to the right above a strip of land. The brushwork features expressive, linear strokes creating textures within the foliage and ground. The color palette consists of warm brown tones against a muted beige background. In the foreground, the ground gently slopes with small plants, and a subtle waterway flows through the scene.

artworks.title: Ruined Stairs at Neuss
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow passageway between tall structures. There is no visible horizon, focusing on the vertical space. The scene features stone steps leading up to an arched brickwork. The architectural details are precise with subtle shading, emphasizing texture. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of grey. A small figure in motion is seen close by with minimal detailing. The image captures an intimate urban setting with light and shadow play in the archway and stairwell.

artworks.title: The Beheading of Saint John the Baptist
artworks.medium: pen and brown and gray ink with red-violet wash, heightened with white, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures in a classical setting. The image depicts characters in historical attire with feathers and armor, showcasing a dynamic scene. One figure is kneeling on the ground and another is reaching towards the person holding a tray. Architectural elements like arches and columns are visible in the background, and the drawing utilizes lines and shading for texture and depth.

artworks.title: Stream through an Ancient Forest
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white gouache on brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a dense wooded area visible from an elevated perspective. The horizon blends into the foliage and trees. A pathway winds from the foreground into the distance through the trees. The artwork features a mix of swirling lines and detailed patterns created with graphite or ink, giving a textured appearance. Earthy tones like brown and black are prevalent, with white highlights adding depth to the trees. The monochromatic color scheme enhances the organic feel of the scene, depicting a woodland environment.

artworks.title: The Triumphal Arch of Maximilian
artworks.medium: 42 woodcuts and 2 etchings on laid paper assembled to form one image
artworks.dimensions: overall size: 354 x 298.5 cm (139 3/8 x 117 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David P. Tunick and Elizabeth S. Tunick, in honor of the appointment of Andrew Robison as Andrew W. Mellon Senior Curator
artworks.description: A stepped, ornately decorated structure made up of forty-four individual woodcuts and etchings printed with black ink on ivory-white paper fills this vertical composition. The structure has a tall central tower flanked by two shorter towers on each side. All three have an arched opening at the bottom. The outer towers are then flanked by three columns. Almost every inch of the structure is densely covered with architectural ornaments, coats of arms, Gothic text, and panels showing scenes with people in interiors or huge crowds in landscapes. Some scenes show soldiers engaged in battle, groups of kings and clergy, or individual men. Architectural ornament includes mythical creatures, gargoyles, saints, kings, and cherubs. The arched openings are tall and narrow, and have checkered floors. Words in elaborate Latin script appear inside the top of each of the three arches. Two ringed-tailed creatures resembling monkeys prowl outside the central arch. Two shallow steps lead down from the structure to five panels that line the base of the composition. Those five panels are filled with Gothic text. The date, "1515," appears at the base of the outermost column to each side.

artworks.title: The Abduction of Helen of Troy
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown wash on gray laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Emile Wolf, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nautical scene with classical elements and mythological themes. In the foreground, there is a large, ornate ship with intricate carvings, including a lion's head at the prow. Several figures are depicted on the ship, one of whom is a standing woman with raised hands, and another figure holding a spear. On the right side, a figure in a helmet with a plume stands on a smaller vessel or a part of a ship, gesturing towards the larger ship. The background features billowing clouds and vague architectural forms. The drawing is rendered in a detailed style typical of classical and mythological illustration.

artworks.title: The Arrival of Aesculapius in Rome
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Emile Wolf, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dragon and several people in a mythological scene. The detailed drawing shows a bustling ancient port with a ship docked on the left side. Various figures are depicted on the ship, some adjusting sails. In the foreground, there are figures interacting. To the right, a domed building with elaborate architectural features is shown as people gather around an altar with rising smoke. In the foreground, a small dragon faces the gathered individuals. The style of the drawing is classical, emphasizing intricate detail and dynamic composition.

artworks.title: Repairing a Dome
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Emile Wolf, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural space with a ground-level perspective. The horizon is suggested through the structure's curvature and elements. The image uses a drawing technique with textured lines and shading. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown and black. Wooden scaffolding structures are on the left, leading to a large archway in the distance. There are arches and openings in the space creating a play of light and shadow, emphasizing the grandeur of the environment.

artworks.title: Christ among the Doctors
artworks.medium: red and black chalks on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Emile Wolf, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art

artworks.title: Louise de Lorraine
artworks.artist: Thomas de Leu after François Quesnel
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This image is an engraving of a portrait showing the upper body of a woman positioned facing forward. Her hair is styled in an elaborate high updo with decorative elements, including a crown-like accessory at the top. Her facial features are finely detailed, with arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes, and a small, slightly closed mouth. She is wearing an opulent dress with a high, lace ruffled collar that fans out around her neck, and her sleeves are puffy and ornamented with patterned fabric. Around her neck, there is a string of pearls and a brooch-like decoration fastening her dress. She is wearing dangling earrings. The background consists of a textured oval frame with text around the border, setting her within a decorative vignette, and beneath the portrait is a section containing French text.

artworks.title: Jeanne d'Albret, Queen of Navarre
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a historical portrait of a person depicted from the waist up, facing forward. The person is in a regal, seated position with a slight turn of the head towards the viewer's left. The facial features include a long, narrow face with high cheekbones, a prominent nose, and thin lips, and the hair is styled swept back and adorned with delicate lace or netting. The clothing is elaborate and ornate, featuring a high ruffled collar, a patterned bodice with rows of decorative buttons, and voluminous, detailed sleeves. Around the subject's neck is a string of pearls. The background is a detailed, textured oval frame with inscriptions, and the space surrounding the subject is filled with lines radiating outwards.

artworks.title: Gentien Hervet, Canon of Reims
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the shoulders up, positioned facing forward. His facial features include a prominent forehead, bushy eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a long nose, and a full beard and mustache. He has a stern expression. He is wearing a round, soft hat with a peak at the front, a buttoned coat with a high collar, and draped fabric around it. There are no visible objects or jewelry being worn. The background is a textured, lined pattern within an oval frame, and there is a decorative border with text running around the oval, indicating the subject's name and titles.

artworks.title: Charles de Gontaut, Duke of Biron
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man shown from the waist up. He is facing forward with his head slightly turned to his right. The man's facial features include a well-defined beard and mustache, with wavy, voluminous hair. He wears an elaborate suit of armor with intricate detailing, including shoulder guards and a high collar with chainmail visible underneath. His expression is serious, and his gaze is directed toward the viewer. There is no visible jewelry or objects held by the person. The background is a textured oval with an inscription around it, reading "CHARLES DE GONTAVT BARON DE BIRON MARESCHAL DE FRANCE," and additional script is present below the oval.

artworks.title: Catherine de Medici, Queen of France
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait displaying the upper body of a person, from the chest upwards. The person is positioned facing slightly to the left, with detailed facial features, wearing a cap-like headpiece with a veil attached and dressed in historical attire. The background is a simple engraved texture, and the portrait is framed within an oval border with surrounding text. Below the portrait is an inscriptive text likely identifying the person and providing additional information.

artworks.title: Antoine Caron
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man facing forward with his head slightly turned to the right. He has deeply set eyes, a high forehead, bushy eyebrows, a full, long beard, and a mustache merging into the beard. He has bald hair on top with fringe on the sides. He is dressed in a detailed buttoned garment with a high collar, resembling a historical outfit. Around him within an oval frame are various artistic instruments like a palette and brushes. The background has a textured or dotted pattern common in engravings. Text surrounds the oval frame and additional text is present below the image.

artworks.title: Henri III, King of France
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a portrait. The man is shown from the upper body up, facing slightly to the right with his head turned towards the viewer. He has a prominent nose, thin lips, and a small pointed beard, along with a neatly trimmed mustache. His hair is styled back and includes an ornate hairpiece or crown with pearls and decorative elements. He is dressed in a high-collared garment resembling a robe with decorative buttons down the front and a sash or ascot across his chest. The man wears a large earring in his left ear. The background features an oval frame with the inscription "HENRY III ROY DE FRANCE ET DE POLOGNE." The name "Thomas de Leu" is credited at the bottom of the image within a border. The background has an engraving-style shading typical of historical portraits.

artworks.title: Seneca
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's portrait from the upper half of his body. He has long wavy hair, a full beard and mustache. The man is turned slightly to his right, looking directly at the viewer. He wears a loose-fitting robe and holds a rolled scroll in his left hand, while his right hand is raised with fingers slightly apart. The background features an oval frame with Latin text, surrounded by flowers at each corner of the square border.

artworks.title: Louis XVI, Henri IV, and Louis XII
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin after Piat Joseph Sauvage
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays three men's heads in profile within an ornate circular frame. Each head is shown from the shoulders up, facing left. The two figures on the left have shorter hair, while the figure on the right has long, wavy hair that flows past the shoulders. The men wear historical clothing with ruffled collars. The circular frame is adorned with a ribbon and laurel design, with the names "LOUIS XIII," "HENRI IV," and "LOUIS XIV" inscribed around the edge. A rectangular scroll below the frame contains elegant calligraphy. The background has a textured pattern, and the composition is set against a plain, light-colored backdrop with some visible spots.

artworks.title: Honoré Fragonard
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a bust portrait of a man in a circular frame. The man has curly, light hair and distinct facial features with a serious expression. He is looking directly at the viewer, wearing a formal dark coat with a high collar and a cravat. The surrounding area has intricate patterns resembling foliage. Below the portrait, there is a textured rectangular area with the inscription "HONORÉ FRAGONARD." The background is a plain beige surface, accentuating the detailed etching in the center.

artworks.title: Louis-Auguste, Dauphin of France
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The detailed engraving depicts a profile portrait of a person from the shoulders up inside an oval frame. The individual is depicted in profile, facing left, with distinct facial features, styled hair, and formal attire typical of the 18th century nobility. The frame surrounding the portrait is ornate with floral motifs and a bow at the top. The engraving is bordered by a patterned rectangular frame with decorative elements. Text below the portrait provides details about the individual, and small text at the bottom credits the creation of the engraving and its location.

artworks.title: Marie-Antoinette
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a person in profile. The person has refined facial features and elaborate hair styled in a classical fashion. They are wearing 18th-century European clothing with lace or ruffles. A decorative border with floral motifs and patterns surrounds the oval portrait. Above the portrait is a ribbon or bow. Below, a rectangular frame contains text identifying the person as Marie Antoinette and providing her birth date. Additional text credits the artist and location. The background features ornate lines and patterns.

artworks.title: Count Ernest Mansfeld
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a man from the waist up, positioned slightly turned to his right with his head facing the viewer. The man has distinct facial features with a prominent nose, a well-groomed beard, and mustache. His hair is coiffed neatly, appearing to be receding at the temples. He is dressed in an ornate jacket with detailed patterns and decorative buttons, and is wearing an elaborate lace ruff around his neck. The man is framed by an oval border that is embellished with scrollwork, which bears text along the curves. The background beyond the oval frame is plain.
